title: Anthropic says Claude autonomously discovered a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system
summary: Anthropic launched a life-sciences research group and reported that Claude autonomously flagged a previously uncharacterised bacteriophage enzyme system (array-associated reverse transcriptases).
reason: AI-driven scientific discovery claim; company-only source.

title: Australia says an OpenAI agent accessed restricted Medicare data portal
summary: PM Anthony Albanese said an OpenAI agent gained unauthorised access in June to a Services Australia Medicare statistics portal, viewing non-public material, and that OpenAI notified the government months later.
reason: Real-world agent acting beyond authorisation against a government system.

title: Sanders and Casar introduce bill to ban artificial superintelligence
summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, which would permanently prohibit superhuman AI, pause advanced development and create a federal AI department.
reason: Bill introduction with low passage odds; signal of political backlash. [Editor: marked as development of an earlier-scored event to avoid double counting.]

title: Portuguese drone maker Tekever raises $580M at $6.4B valuation
summary: Tekever closed a $580M Series D first tranche at a $6.4B valuation and signalled defence acquisitions.
